title: Staffing Matcher — availability-aware ranked shortlist
intelligence_boundary_rule: Every ranking/availability judgement is a Claude call (injected double in tests), Zod-validated before use. Tests assert the CALL BOUNDARY + VALIDATION + GRACEFUL FAILURE + result RELATIONSHIPS — never hardcoded keyword/regex/date logic.
iteration_3_revision_note: Revised for 2 new reviewer findings (the 6 iteration-2 findings were confirmed RESOLVED): F-01 (CRITICAL) — callClaude runs schema.safeParse(raw) INTERNALLY (claude.ts:132) before the core maps results->shortlist, and the authored test scripts the Claude double with a bare array (AC-04 test:66-87, AC-05 test:127-136) and a shortlist-keyed object (AC-21 test:152-158) which makeClaudeClientSpy JSON.stringifies verbatim; a plain z.object({results:[...]}) would reject them so AC-04/05/21 could never go GREEN. FIX: MatchResult is now z.preprocess(coerceModelShape, z.object({...})) coercing array|{shortlist,...}|{results,...} -> {results,...} BEFORE object validation (entry-level matchPercent 0..100 etc. unchanged; BR-09 intact; TACTICAL-ADR-S3-05). S3-P1-01 updated to assert both coercions + rejection of invalid/legacy shapes. F-02 (LOW) LOC reconciled to ~392 throughout.
iteration_2_revision_note: Revised for 6 reviewer findings, each re-verified against the repo: F-01 tests/setup/test-helpers.ts must add loadModule + SYNTHETIC_PROFILES (the authored test imports both; repo file exports only the three makeClaudeClient* doubles); F-02 canonical CoreProfileRecord reconciles the authored profile shape with buildMatchDataset output without dropping trustState/seniority/timezone; F-03 ranking-rules system prompt + dataset go in cacheableContext (claude.ts:118 wires cacheableContext->system), query in the user turn; F-04 roles are ADMIN|MANAGER|PRACTICE_LEAD|EMPLOYEE (no HR token); F-05 AC-24 out-of-scope (deferred SKILL-6); F-06 S3-P3-05 garbled-JSON is ADDITIVE (not in authored test).

phases.name: Baseline (RED) + harness wiring + helper extension
phases.goal: EXTEND tests/setup/test-helpers.ts with loadModule + SYNTHETIC_PROFILES (F-01 — the authored test imports both, the repo file exports neither); adapt the authored staffing-matcher.test.ts into the repo Vitest harness; confirm meaningful RED on the missing core import; wire the single-file command.

scenarios.title: Helper imports resolve and the suite fails RED until the core is implemented
scenarios.given: tests/setup/test-helpers.ts now exports loadModule<T>(specifier) + SYNTHETIC_PROFILES (in the authored profile record shape {id,handle,currentProject,allocationPct,freeFrom,skills:[{canonicalSkillId,name,level}]}) ALONGSIDE the three existing makeClaudeClient* doubles; tests/staffing-matcher.test.ts imports { loadModule, SYNTHETIC_PROFILES, makeClaudeClientSpy, makeClaudeClientThatThrows } and loads runStaffingSearch via loadModule('@/lib/match/run-staffing-search')
scenarios.when: the suite runs before the core exists
scenarios.then: the helper imports resolve (F-01 regression closed — without the additive exports the suite could not import) and the suite fails RED at loadModule's dynamic import of the missing core module (a meaningful RED, not a misleading assertion), using no live Anthropic call
scenarios.test_function: RED baseline — helper imports + module-under-test import

phases.name: Schema + prompt contract
phases.goal: Rewrite MatchResult to Page 02 §2.5 + authored-test shape, wrapped in z.preprocess(coerceModelShape, z.object({...})) so the model's bare-array / shortlist-keyed / results-keyed encodings are canonicalized to {results,...} before object validation (F-01, required because callClaude validates raw internally at claude.ts:132); extend match-staffing prompt to render {queryText, datasetJson} with availability + trust-weighting rules.

scenarios.title: MatchResult validates §2.5, COERCES the model's bare-array + shortlist-keyed encodings, and rejects legacy/invalid shapes (F-01)
scenarios.given: four payloads exactly as the authored test scripts the Claude double (makeClaudeClientSpy JSON.stringifies them verbatim, so these are what callClaude's internal safeParse sees): (a) canonical { results:[{profileId,matchPercent,matchedSkills[],gaps[],availability,rationale,rank?,inRequestedWindow?}], shortfallNote?, requested? }; (b) a BARE ARRAY of result entries (AC-04 test:66-87 / AC-05 test:127-136); (c) an object keyed { shortlist:[...], shortfallNote } (AC-21 test:152-158); and the negatives: (d) the legacy { matches:[{handle,score}] } stub, (e) an entry with matchPercent out of 0..100
scenarios.when: MatchResult.safeParse is called on each (the schema's z.preprocess(coerceModelShape,...) runs before the inner z.object validation — mirroring callClaude's internal claude.ts:132 gate)
scenarios.then: (a) validates with all BR-05 fields; (b) the bare array is coerced to { results:[...] } and validates; (c) the shortlist key is renamed to results (shortfallNote preserved) and validates; (d) the legacy { matches } shape FAILS (SKILL-1 stub superseded); (e) the out-of-range matchPercent FAILS — coercion did NOT weaken entry-level validation (BR-09 intact)

scenarios.title: Ranking rules + dataset are in the cacheable context; the rendered user turn carries the query ONLY (F-03)
scenarios.given: the match-staffing template rendered with { queryText } only, and the core's assembled cacheableContext = RANKING_RULES_PROMPT + serialized dataset
scenarios.when: the messages array (renderPrompt) + the cacheableContext (system arg) are assembled
scenarios.then: the RANKING_RULES_PROMPT (instructing ranking over allocation+freeFrom and trust weighting VERIFIED>MANAGER_APPROVED>SELF_REPORTED) AND the serialized dataset appear in the cacheable system context — NOT in the per-request user turn; the per-request queryText is the only content in the user turn; the match-staffing template contains neither the ranking rules nor the dataset (claude.ts:118 wires cacheableContext->system)

phases.name: Role-scoped deterministic dataset builder
phases.goal: buildMatchDataset(session) -> CoreProfileRecord[] (canonical record, F-02): role-scoped (BR-03; MANAGER/ADMIN->org, PRACTICE_LEAD->team, EMPLOYEE->Denied; no HR token per schema.prisma:15), deterministic, stably-ordered, carrying trustState/seniority/timezone; Employee denied; PL team-only; empty-team safe.

scenarios.title: Practice Lead dataset contains only team members
scenarios.given: a PRACTICE_LEAD session whose team is a subset of seeded employees (leadId == caller.id)
scenarios.then: only employees with leadId == caller.id are included; no org-wide profiles leak into a PL dataset

scenarios.title: Employee role is denied a dataset
scenarios.then: it returns a Denied marker; no org-wide dataset is ever built for an Employee and no Claude call is made downstream

scenarios.title: Serialization is deterministic (byte-identical for identical input)
scenarios.given: the same in-scope profile set normalized to CoreProfileRecord[]
scenarios.when: serializeDataset is called twice (the loop's before/after re-run)
scenarios.then: the two serialized strings are identical (stable ordering by profileId, skills by canonical name; trustState/seniority/timezone carried deterministically) so the Anthropic prompt-cache key is reused

scenarios.title: Practice Lead with no team yields an empty dataset, never an error
scenarios.given: a PRACTICE_LEAD session whose leadId matches nobody
scenarios.then: the dataset is empty (no team members) and the builder does not throw
scenarios.test_function: dataset role-scope — empty PL team safe

phases.name: Matching core + four branches
phases.goal: runStaffingSearch({query,profiles,claude}) → Opus call (dataset cacheable) → MatchResult → happy / hard-match / partial-quantity / failure.

scenarios.title: Availability-aware ranked match — in-window candidate ranks above equally-skilled out-of-window
scenarios.given: a Manager query '2 React + Node devs, free now or within 2 weeks, IST overlap' and two candidates in the AUTHORED profile record shape ({id,handle,currentProject,allocationPct,freeFrom,skills:[{canonicalSkillId,name,level}]}) with IDENTICAL skill overlap differing ONLY in availability (p-002 free now / in-window; p-001 free ~6 weeks / out-of-window); the Claude double is scripted with a BARE ARRAY of two entries (equal matchPercent) — makeClaudeClientSpy JSON.stringifies it verbatim, so callClaude's internal safeParse (claude.ts:132) sees a bare array, which MatchResult's coerceModelShape wraps as {results:[...]} (F-01); runStaffingSearch normalizes both profiles via toCoreRecord to CoreProfileRecord (id->profileId, allocationPct->allocation; trustState/seniority/timezone null on this test path)
scenarios.when: runStaffingSearch is invoked with the injected claude double
scenarios.then: claude.createMessage is called exactly once; result.ok is true; each shortlist entry has matchPercent/matchedSkills/gaps/availability/rationale (BR-05); the in-window candidate ranks above the equally-skilled out-of-window one (lower rank number / earlier index) and inRequestedWindow flags the two correctly — proving availability, not skills, drove ordering

scenarios.title: Hard match — closest people + gap/ramp-up, never empty
scenarios.given: a niche-skill query where no profile is a perfect fit and the Claude double is scripted with a BARE ARRAY of one entry — the closest person with non-empty gaps and ramp-up wording (AC-05 test:127-136); callClaude's internal safeParse sees the bare array, which coerceModelShape wraps as {results:[...]} (F-01)
scenarios.then: result.ok is true; shortlist is non-empty; the top entry carries explicit gaps[] (ramp-up analysis) — never an empty list

scenarios.title: Partial-quantity fulfillment — fewer-than-requested qualifiers + shortfallNote
scenarios.given: a '3 mid-level React devs free within 2 weeks' query where the Claude double is scripted with a SHORTLIST-KEYED object { shortlist:[2 qualifiers], shortfallNote:'2 of 3 requested qualify' } (AC-21 test:152-158) — callClaude's internal safeParse (claude.ts:132) sees that object, which MatchResult's coerceModelShape renames shortlist->results while preserving shortfallNote (F-01)
scenarios.then: result.ok is true; shortlist.length is 2 (not zero, not a silent drop); shortfallNote matches /2 of 3/

scenarios.title: Search failure — Claude unreachable (throws) → retry message, no results
scenarios.then: result.ok is false; userMessage is exactly 'Search is temporarily unavailable — please retry.'; no shortlist/results are exposed and no partial/garbled ranking is constructed

scenarios.title: ADDITIVE (not in authored test) — garbled JSON fails Zod → retry message, no results
scenarios.additive_rationale: F-06: the authored test only covers the SDK-throw failure reason (S3-P3-04). This scenario is ADDITIVE coverage for the second distinct callClaude failure reason (extract/parse via makeClaudeClientGarbled) — it is NOT part of the authored acceptance test and is contributed by the planner to harden the AC-06 failure gate.
scenarios.given: a Claude double returning malformed JSON (makeClaudeClientGarbled — already exported by tests/setup/test-helpers.ts)
scenarios.then: the callClaude Zod/extract gate fails → result.ok is false with the exact retry message; never coerced/repaired into a shown ranking
scenarios.test_function: AC-06 failure — invalid JSON Zod gate (additive)

scenarios.title: Opus routing + dataset-in-cacheable-context
scenarios.given: a valid scripted MatchResult and the injected claude double
scenarios.then: the boundary (claude.createMessage) is invoked with the Opus model id (route('hard')) and its system arg (= cacheableContext) carries BOTH the RANKING_RULES_PROMPT and the serialized dataset, while the messages user turn carries the per-request query ONLY — asserted via the spy call args (system vs messages). F-03: confirms the ranking rules are cached, not in the user turn.

phases.name: Read-only transport + role gate
phases.goal: POST /api/match thin transport: re-derive role server-side (MANAGER/ADMIN->org, PRACTICE_LEAD->team, EMPLOYEE->denied; no HR token), deny Employee, build scoped dataset, delegate to core, no DB writes (TS-003). AC-24 stale-session redirect is OUT OF SCOPE (deferred to SKILL-6, F-05).

scenarios.title: Employee calling the matcher is denied before any model call
scenarios.given: an EMPLOYEE-scoped session reaching the match path
scenarios.when: the matcher composition (route → buildMatchDataset) runs for that session
scenarios.then: the Denied path is taken; no dataset is built and no Claude call is made; the Employee receives no results

scenarios.title: Transport surfaces the retry message on core failure with no partial ranking
scenarios.given: the core returns { ok:false, userMessage } (Claude failure)
scenarios.when: the route maps the core result to a response
scenarios.then: the response carries the retry message and no results[]; the handler performs no DB write (TS-003 read-only)
